rotation: For heldout index i in [WPY,WOH,WQQ], fit (i+1)%3 and calibrate (i+2)%3. No overlap.
models: HGB unchanged60iterations15leaves, ball Alive fit natural+originaldropout, player Alive natural; fixed R6M2 Home head (trained on non-test matches, not calibrated)
calibration: C=1 sigmoid logit calibration of each Alive expert on separate match natural+dropout 2Hz samples; singleclass refuses fit
gate: Same G1 quality gate, .5 logit weight for player when eligible, otherwise ball; fixed before results, no learned gate
comparison: G2_uncal vs G2_cal with identical training data and Home head. Natural/dropout/long complete25Hz. Does not isolate calibration if compared against two-match G1.
decision: Only exploratory unless improvement on >=2/3 matches in missing domains, no >.01 natural spell loss, no >.02 trueDmiss rate increase. Calibration does not certify crossprovider transfer.
preservation: No refits when model+hash receipt exists. New output calibration-v1. No holdouts/targetGT.
